lines.en: Ingrid, the film, which I’d been waiting for since spring, finally opened last night, and I went straight away.
lines.pt: Ingrid, o filme, que eu esperava desde a primavera, finalmente estreou ontem à noite, e fui na hora.

lines.en: Lucky you! Your sister, who had been telling everyone about it, must be so excited.
lines.pt: Que sorte! Sua irmã, que vinha contando a todo mundo sobre ele, deve estar muito animada.

lines.en: She is. The director, whose last film I had been dreaming about for years, has made something special.
lines.pt: Está. O diretor, cujo último filme eu sonhava havia anos, fez algo especial.

lines.en: I’d been hoping to see it too, but the cinema, which had been fully booked all week, sold out.
lines.pt: Eu também esperava vê-lo, mas o cinema, que estava lotado a semana toda, esgotou os ingressos.

lines.en: Try the small one on Pine Street, where I had been working as a ticket seller before I changed jobs.
lines.pt: Tente o pequeno da Rua Pine, onde eu trabalhava como vendedora de ingressos antes de mudar de emprego.

lines.en: Really? I didn’t know you had been working there. Was it hard to watch films all day?
lines.pt: Sério? Não sabia que você trabalhava lá. Era difícil assistir a filmes o dia todo?

lines.en: Not at all. The manager, who had been running the place for thirty years, let us watch for free.
lines.pt: Nem um pouco. O gerente, que dirigia o lugar havia trinta anos, nos deixava assistir de graça.

lines.en: Nice. And the lead actress, who had obviously been preparing for months, deserves an award for this role.
lines.pt: Legal. E a atriz principal, que claramente vinha se preparando havia meses, merece um prêmio por esse papel.

lines.en: She does. The ending, which I won’t spoil, had me in tears. I had been laughing a minute before!
lines.pt: Merece. O final, que não vou estragar, me fez chorar. Eu estava rindo um minuto antes!

lines.en: Stop, you are making me jealous. I’ve been looking at tickets all afternoon, and the late show has seats.
lines.pt: Para, você está me deixando com inveja. Estou olhando ingressos a tarde toda, e a sessão da noite tem lugares.

lines.en: Book them now. The soundtrack, which is beautiful, deserves a big screen and a good sound system.
lines.pt: Reserve agora. A trilha sonora, que é linda, merece uma tela grande e um bom sistema de som.

facts.label: Filmes esperados
facts.sub: The film, which I’d been waiting for, opened. My sister, who had been telling everyone, is excited. The director, whose last film I loved, is here.

facts.label: , which / , who
facts.sub: Use vírgulas para acrescentar informação extra: The film, which I’d been waiting for, opened. Não se pode omitir essa parte sem mudar o sentido da frase principal. Não use that.

facts.label: who, whose
facts.sub: Use who para pessoas: My sister, who had been telling everyone. Use whose para posse: The director, whose last film I loved. Em português: “que” e “cujo”.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We can use that in a non-defining clause.
I’d been waiting is the past perfect continuous.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Non-defining relative clauses use commas. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We can use that in a non-defining clause. → Falso (We use which or who.)
I’d been waiting is the past perfect continuous. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A film worth the wait · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a drizzly evening in Portland. Edith walks out of the cinema with a smile. She calls Paulo from the sidewalk. He has been waiting for this film too. Their conversation quickly gets lively. Paulo grabs his jacket and keys.

“Paulo, the film, which I’d been waiting for since spring, finally opened last night, and I went straight away.” says Edith. “Lucky you! Your sister, who had been telling everyone about it, must be so excited.” says Paulo. “She is. The director, whose last film I had been dreaming about for years, has made something special.” says Edith.
